'''Banthazolate''' was a type of illegal narcotic that took the form of a green-colored powder and when consumed, it caused the user to experience psychedelic hallucinations. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a rival firm of the company [[Mothven Star Trading]] sabotaged a package that was due to be delivered to Mothven's headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. They filled the parcel with an explosive device and a quantity of banthazolate with a street value of 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and the saboteurs hoped that the device would detonate and scatter banthazolate throughout Mothven's headquarters. However, before the package could be delivered, [[Heroes of Cularin|the couriers]] hired to transport it were arrested by the [[Office of Peace and Security]]&mdash;a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]]&mdash;which confiscated the banthazolate.
